Changelog

0.3.0 — 2026-10-21

  • Add bounded transactional History<D> snapshots, explicit coalescing, undo/redo labels and saved checkpoints for application engines.
  • Count retained redo snapshots as well as undo in the history byte budget.
  • Route Screenshot document edits through parameterised commands. The screenshot.execute body rejects unknown fields (deny_unknown_fields).
  • Rename Screenshot's nullary Delete selection command from edit.delete to edit.delete_selected; keymap overrides naming the old command must move to edit.delete_selected. edit.delete {id} now deletes one object.

0.2.0 — 2026-10-21

  • Emit only v2 executed bodies, with accepted params and returned result; independently replace compact values above 4096 bytes with bytes and SHA-256.
  • Add the strict, schema-bearing ExecuteRequest body for <app>.execute.
  • Canonicalise modifiers as Ctrl, Alt, Shift and report stored chord spelling through toolkit's <app>.actions adapter.

0.1.0 — 2026-10-20

  • Extract the registry, Fluent strings and v1 executed journal from toolkit.
  • Add parameter schemas, results, typed refusals and classes.
  • Preserve toolkit's nullary tables through its egui adapter.
